messages.author: d44403f22991e7ef
messages.subject: Using GGIR with movisens
parts:
Dear all,

I am currently trying to run GGIR on movisens data and already found out that this should be working. I have to say that I am an absolute newbie when it comes to GGIR and accelerometry data processing and analyzing, but I have worked quite a bit with R. I installed "GGIR", "remotes" and "wadpac/GGIR" in order to be able to use the data from movisens. I tried to use the data with "read.myacc.csv". Unfortunately, it did not work, it does not seem to be able to read the data (Error message: No files to analyse). It would be very helpful if there was an example script/code on how to use movisens data. Maybe you could help me, I would very much appreciate that. 
Thank you a lot in advance.


Best regards

Verena

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Using GGIR with movisens
parts:
Hi,

The function to read the movisens data is not included into the read.myacc.csv function, but in the g.readaccfile function. You should just specify the datadir as the directory where your movisens participants folders are stored. The rest of the GGIR functionality is the same as with any other brand. Pls, let me know if you keep getting problems with this.

Best,
Jairo
